def oxford_join_numbers(numbers):
    match numbers:
        case []:
            return ''
        case [x]:
            return str(x)
        case [x, y]:
            return f"{x} and {y}"
        case [x, y, z]:
            return f"{x}, {y}, and {z}"
        case [x, y, *rest]:
            return f"{x}, {y}, and {rest}"
        case _:
            return ''
